preparation_accounting: One fresh source-only Claude Opus medium catalog call is physically shared. Every condition headline includes its FULL preparation time and usage; cohort actual-once and per-arm one-quarter amortized quantities are separate secondary metrics.
deadline_basis: Each fresh arm has an explicit 14400-second overall deadline. Worker, decision and check calls receive remaining arm time; no separate 10-minute worker cap. Catalog preparation has the same 14400-second deadline and its measured time is added to each headline arm total.
session_semantics: Held-out h2 catalog preparation only (R20261017-EVAL-PROTOCOL stage-1 pilot): D066 v1 source-only catalog prompt and schema applied to the h2 public instruction; arms are listed for schema validity and are not run from this manifest.
independent_grade: Root-owned after candidate freeze; hidden tests and hidden failure details never enter planning, implementation or public repair. Successful completion time remains null until independently successful.
